name: Wraith, Magus
body:
Magus Wraith CR 10

XP 9,600
LE Medium undead (incorporeal)
Init +7; Senses darkvision 60 ft., lifesense; Perception +10
Aura unnatural aura (30 ft.)

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 18, flat-footed 14 (+5 deflection, +3 Dex)
hp 117 (15d8+50)
Fort +6, Ref +4, Will +9
Defensive Abilities channel resistance +4, incorporeal; Immune undead traits
Weaknesses sunlight powerlessness

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee incorporeal touch +3 (2d6 negative energy plus 1d6 Con drain)

STATISTICS

Str —; Dex 16, Con —; Int 19; Wis 16; Cha 17
Base Atk +3; CMB +6; CMD 21
Feats Blind-Fight, Combat Reflexes, Improved Initiative, Improved Natural Armor
Skills Diplomacy +8, Fly +7, Intimidate +11, Knowledge (magic) +19, Perception +13, Sense Motive +8, Stealth +11
Languages Common

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Spellcasting

A magus wraith casts spells as a 15rd-level necromancer (wizard).

Constitution Drain (Su)

Creatures hit by a magus wraith’s touch attack must succeed on a DC 20 Fortitude save or take 1d6 points of Constitution drain. On each successful attack, the magus wraith gains 5 temporary hit points. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Lifesense (Su)

A magus wraith notices and locates living creatures within 60 feet, just as if it possessed the blindsight ability.

Sunlight Powerlessness (Ex)

A magus wraith caught in sunlight cannot attack and is staggered.

Unnatural Aura (Su)

Animals do not willingly approach within 30 feet of a magus wraith, unless a master makes a DC 25 Handle Animal, Ride, or wild empathy check.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard

A magus wraith is created when a necromancer vies for magical immortality beyond the grave by targeting themself in the casting of create greater undead. The magus wraith retains their living spell casting level, but cannot earn experience or progress in levels. Magus wraiths do not create undead spawn, but gain other wraith-like undead attributes.
